title: CelestialPhysicalEstimates
description: Gameplay/scan estimates, separate from physicalCatalog. Mission asteroids generate these estimates. Catalog seeding currently projects catalog massKg and twice meanRadiusKm into these fields, using zero when those source fields are unavailable; zero therefore means no usable estimate, not a measured zero. Selection precedence is documented by CelestialPhysicalCatalog; no read-time recalculation or merging.

estimatedDiameterM.description: Estimated diameter in metres, not radius; radius km = diameter / 2000.
